title: Improvement: Support dynamic AWS client updates via caching and remove unused config
body:
Fixes: #27

**Why:**
AWS SQS clients were tightly coupled to `SystemMessageRemote` and cached in a static `ConcurrentHashMap`. Runtime config changes were ignored because the outdated client remained active.

**What changed:**
- **Cache Implementation:** Migrated the static client storage to Moqui's cache (`aws.sqs.tool`). This ensures the client can be easily cleared, discarded, and recreated with updated credentials/endpoints at runtime.
- **Code Cleanup:** Removed unused default AWS properties from `MoquiConf.xml`.
- **Seed Data Enhancement:** Provided default mock data in `AwsSeedData.xml`.

linkedIssues.body:
Updating `SystemMessageRemote` values at runtime currently fails to invalidate the existing AWS client because it is stored in a static `ConcurrentHashMap`. This causes the client to keep pointing to the old or incorrect remote.

**Goal:** 
- Replace the static map with Moqui's Cache so clearing it ensures the client closes and correctly recreates on the next usage.
- Clean up unused default AWS properties (`SQS_AWS_REGION`, etc.) from the XML configuration.
linkedIssues.title: Support dynamic AWS client updates by decoupling from system message remote

title: Upgrade webhook payload to support external URIs matching Shopify GraphQL schema
body:
Closes: #270 

Recent Shopify GraphQL API versions have modified how Webhook Subscription endpoints are supplied and queried. Additionally, the existing platform logic forcefully prepended internal Webapp root URLs, which broke the capability to register remote target URIs (like AWS EventBridge ARNs).

This PR introduces updates so that standard endpoints and AWS ARNs can be subscribed reliably via the webhook creation services.

## Technical Changes
- **ShopifyWebhookServices.xml**: Adjusted the `endPoint` validation conditional. If an endpoint starts with `arn:aws:events:` or `http`, the service now bypasses local host root appending, keeping remote URIs completely intact.
- **WebhookSubscriptionCreate.ftl**: Updated the input payload from `callbackUrl` to the newly required `uri`.
- **WebhookSubscriptionsQuery.ftl**: 
  - Subscriptions API now requests up to 10 records at once instead of just 1.
  - Replaced the heavily nested and deprecated `endpoint.WebhookHttpEndpoint` query with just `uri`.
  - Updated the `topics` argument in queries to use an array structure `[${queryParams.topics}]` as mandated by newly enforced GraphQL spec.

linkedIssues.body:
**Problem:**
Due to recent Shopify GraphQL Admin API version upgrades, the existing webhook subscription endpoints and mutations are either deprecated or functioning differently. Furthermore, the existing implementation lacked support for subscribing to external remote endpoints (like AWS EventBridge ARNs or Google Cloud Pub/Sub), which is necessary for our newer order integration.

**Proposed Solution:**
Upgrade the webhook management services and their corresponding GraphQL templates to align with the latest Shopify API version and support remote external endpoints.
linkedIssues.title: Update Shopify Webhook services to support newer API versions and external endpoints

title: [Feature] Include item-level details in Transfer Order Acknowledgment Feed
body:
Closes: #207 
## Summary
This PR enhances the Transfer Order Acknowledgment Feed to include item-level details, as requested in issue #207. Previously, the feed only provided order-level synchronization info. Now, it generates a record for each item in the Transfer Order, including internal NetSuite Item IDs and HotWax Item Sequence IDs.

## Changes
- **TransferOrderViewEntities.xml**: Created `TransferOrderItemAckView` to join `OrderHeader`, `OrderItem`, and `OrderIdentification`. This view retrieves both order-level and item-level data necessary for the acknowledgment.
- **TransferOrderServices.xml**: Updated `generate#TransferOrderSyncAckFeed` to use the new view entity. Modified the `CsvWriteHelper` to include `itemId` (NetSuite Item ID) and `externalId` (HotWax Item Sequence ID) in the CSV output.

## Mapping Details
- `internalId`: NetSuite Internal Order ID (from `OrderIdentification`)
- `hcOrderId`: HotWax Order ID (from `OrderHeader`)
- `lineId`: NetSuite Internal Item ID (from `OrderItem.externalId`)
- `externalId`: HotWax Item Sequence ID (from `OrderItem.orderItemSeqId`)

## Verification
- Verified the view entity logic for joining required tables.
- Verified the service logic for CSV generation with the updated headers and data mapping.

linkedIssues.body:
### Objective
Enhance the **Transfer Order Acknowledgment Feed** to include item-level records. Currently, it likely handles orders at a header level or lacks specific item mappings required for synchronization.

### Proposed Changes
1. **Item-Level Grain**: The feed should generate one row per item in the transfer order.
2. **Field Mapping**:
   - **itemId**: Should be populated with the NetSuite internal ID, sourced from `order_item.external_id`.
   - **externalId**: Should be populated with the HotWax Commerce (HC) item sequence ID.
3. **NetSuite Configuration**:
   - A new custom field needs to be created in NetSuite at the item level to store the HotWax item sequence ID.
4. **Connector Mapping**: Update the mapping logic in `mantle-netsuite-connector` to support these new fields and the item-level row generation.

### Details
- **Source for itemId**: `order_item.external_id` (NetSuite ID)
- **Source for externalId**: HC Item Sequence ID (Order Item Seq ID)
linkedIssues.title: [Feature] Include item-level details in Transfer Order Acknowledgment Feed

title: Improvement: Standardized service-level log messages in OrderRouting
body:
### Summary

This PR updates and standardizes `<log>` statements in across multiple service modules to follow Moqui logging best practices. Existing logs were refactored to use a consistent, structured format with relevant contextual details (e.g., entity identifiers, service context, outcomes), improving log clarity and searchability.

Issue: #110 

### Scope

Logging changes were made in the following service modules:
- CommonServices
- OrderRoutingServices

No functional or behavioral changes were introduced; the updates are limited strictly to logging improvements.

### Validation

Developer testing was performed by executing the affected services via the Service Run UI and validating the updated logs in runtime/Grafana across dev and test environments.

linkedIssues.body:
Apply standardized logging practices to the **`OrderRouting`** component repository in alignment with Moqui framework logging best practices.

The goal is to improve log consistency, clarity, and debuggability by updating existing `<log>` statements to follow a uniform, structured format.

### Parent ticket - [#358](https://github.com/hotwax/hotwax-oms/issues/358)
---

## Scope of Work

- Review all existing `<log>` messages in the repository services.
- Refactor log messages to follow the standardized pattern:


- Ensure logs include meaningful contextual details where applicable (e.g., entity IDs, order IDs, facility IDs, statuses)
- Avoid vague or generic log messages

---

## Examples

### Good

```
xml
<log level="error"
   message="Inventory [Product ID: ${productId}] - Insufficient stock at Facility ${facilityId}"/>
```

---

## Reference

[Moqui Logging Best Practices](https://github.com/saastechacademy/foundation/blob/main/moqui-framework/bestpractices/log-messages.md)
